fragments.text:
Compliance and confidentiality regulations
## Statements and personal data
Account statements may be sent only to the email address registered to the
account holder. Sending a statement to any other address is a personal data
breach.

Notifications
## Delivery failures
If the registered email bounces three times the address is marked unverified
and statement delivery is suspended until it is corrected.

Escalation policy
## Mandatory escalation triggers
The agent must escalate to a human agent when: suspected fraud is reported on a
settled transaction above EUR 10,000; the customer explicitly asks for a human;
the request needs an action the agent has no tool for; a dispute is blocked by a
customer-level restriction; the customer disputes a figure the agent quoted.

Payment dispute rules
## Escalation on blocked disputes
When a dispute is blocked by a customer-level restriction, the case must be
escalated to a human agent.
